dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O'-shaped structures on the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit irregular, crenulated outer perimeters with high-contrast transitions from the dark background pixels to the high-intensity cream-colored interior rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity clusters observed predominantly in the anterior-dorsal region and interspersed between larger macro-annuli; these clusters lack internal structural gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle across the mid-lateral body segment, while a secondary sequence of smaller blobs forms a curvilinear path along the dorsal ridge.
